# QAMAR Blowdry Lounge — Dubai

> Women-only walk-in blow-dry lounge opening in Dubai in March 2027, off Sheikh Zayed Road. No appointment: guests join a live queue from their phone and every look on the menu takes 45 minutes or less. Private shower, outfit (dress, abaya, hijab) steamed and lightly perfumed while you shower, blow-dry, and a drink before you leave. Bilingual English / Arabic.

- Website (English): https://qamarlounge.com/
- Website (Arabic): https://qamarlounge.com/ar.html
- Live queue: https://qamarlounge.com/queue.html
- Guides: https://qamarlounge.com/guides/get-ready-after-work-dubai.html · https://qamarlounge.com/guides/blow-dry-dubai-humidity.html · https://qamarlounge.com/guides/steam-abaya-hijab.html
